Moving identity, policy and device management from Active Directory to Microsoft Entra ID, Intune and Azure Arc by attribute rather than by organizational unit: HR attributes drive groups, policy and access, Group Policy becomes code, servers come under Arc and Ansible, and a drift pipeline keeps the evidence.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.
